Boca Raton, Florida

Trieste at Boca Raton

A 24-hour guard-gated community of 109 luxury townhomes by Toll Brothers — where Mediterranean elegance meets the South Florida lifestyle.

🏛️

Our Community

Trieste at Boca Raton is a 24-hour guard-gated HOA community of luxuriously crafted townhomes, situated in an ideal east Boca Raton location. Developed by Toll Brothers, one of South Florida's top luxury builders, Trieste at Boca Raton townhomes boast elegant Mediterranean-inspired architecture, exquisite designer details, and exceptional quality craftsmanship.

With award-winning landscaping throughout the community, fiber-to-the-home internet & TV infrastructure, and a world-class pool and spa, Trieste at Boca Raton is the perfect place to enjoy the laid-back South Florida lifestyle.

🏠

The Residences

Nestled on over 12 tropically landscaped acres, the community features 109 three-story townhomes with two-car garages and from 2,850 to over 3,000 square feet of living space. Features commonly found in Trieste townhomes include split-bedroom floor plans, upgraded hardwood and Saturnia marble flooring, vaulted ceilings, and gourmet kitchens with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances.

Additional features include both gas and electric utilities with tankless water heaters, luxurious master suites with walk-in closets and marble baths, hurricane impact windows, private backyards, and two-car garages. Many homes also feature private elevators and full outdoor kitchens.

📍

Location & Setting

Trieste at Boca Raton is located at 5700 North Federal Highway in the heart of East Boca Raton, FL. The community is conveniently situated near many of the area's finest shopping, dining, and entertainment options, as well as a wide range of nearby recreational destinations.

Trieste at Boca Raton is close to Spanish River Park, Gumbo Limbo Nature Center, and Lake Wyman Park, and is just a short distance from Boca Raton's beautiful beaches. The property is ideally situated between Downtown Delray Beach to the north and Mizner Park to the south.

For additional questions about the Trieste at Boca Raton community, please contact us at management@trieste.com or call (561) 555-0100.
